item.title: Thinking About Working After Retirement? Start with These 5 Questions
item.description: For many women, retirement isn’t the finish line we once imagined. Instead, it often becomes a moment of reflection, a chance to ask, What’s next? More women today are working after retirement, not because they have to, but because they want to stay engaged, contribute their experience, or create a new sense of purpose.

item.title: The Sentence We Carry
item.description: A woman over 60 wrote to me not long ago. She had written something for a friend who was leaving for another job. It wasn’t dramatic or elaborate. It was simply honest – an expression of how much she had valued the friendship, how much she would miss her, and how hard it felt to say goodbye...

item.title: Writing Your Memoir Is Easier Than You Think
item.description: I’ve heard it many times in my classes: Your family and friends want you to write your memoir. They say you’ve had an interesting life, and you have such great stories to tell. They want it all in writing for their kids, your grandkids. But who has the time? And really, is your life all that interesting?

item.title: Solo Trip to Japan at 66? These 5 Apps Made It Stress-Free
item.description: I just returned from a two-week solo trip to Japan. Whether you’re traveling across the world or just heading out of town for a few days, a few simple apps can take the mystery out of being in a foreign land and make your trip so much more fun.
